general.notes: Datasheet title/part LS-SM311G-20C: standard operating case temperature 0 to +70°C per Recommended Operating Conditions and Ordering information. Extended (-20 to +85°C) and Industrial (-40 to +85°C) grades appear in the same document for other orderable parts (e.g. LS-SM311G-20I). Receiver sensitivity and overload per Note 3: PRBS 2^7-1 @1250Mbps, BER ≤1×10^-12. Average output power Note 1: launched into SMF. Supply current Icc max 300 mA at 3.135–3.465 V; power in watts not stated. Transmitter centre wavelength 1260–1360 nm (typ 1310 nm); receiver centre wavelength 1260–1610 nm. Spectral width (RMS) Δλ max 3 nm. SMSR row has no numeric limits.
